title: I am developing a supermarket checkout simulator called Guichê 7.
author: Glittering_Screen_14
selftext:
https://reddit.com/link/1y6795y/video/jmlrotj1vz3i1/player

I am developing a game called \*Guichê 7\* (Checkout 7), a supermarket cashier simulator set during the night shift.



The concept is quite simple: you work as a cashier at a supermarket at night, scanning products, processing payments, bagging groceries, and dealing with all sorts of different customers. The game will feature various events, unexpected situations, a narrative, and multiple endings.



To be completely transparent: when I say I am "developing" this game, what I actually mean is that I am coming up with the ideas and guiding an AI on what needs to be done. Visually, the game is heavily inspired by \*Papers, Please\*—a title whose art style I absolutely love. I’ve always been a huge fan of that aesthetic and wanted to bring some of that atmosphere into a completely different setting: a supermarket during the night shift.



The video shows just a few of the mechanics implemented so far. I have many other ideas and features that I plan to add as development progresses.



I’m sharing some screenshots and videos of the current progress. I’d love to hear what you think!



Would you be interested in playing something like this? What would you like to see added to the game?
